poin.isi: Oracle introduced Fusion Claw (September 29), a layer that lets AI agents do real work inside core business systems: financial reconciliation, staffing plans, and supply chains.
What sets it apart is not the model but clear boundaries: goals, permissions, risk thresholds, and who approves. Every step is recorded and auditable.
A useful agent is one that knows its limits. Start with the single task that eats the most time, with clear rules and approvals from day one.

headline: AGENTS MOVE INTO CORE SYSTEMS,
CONTROL STAYS IN YOUR HANDS
headline_caption: Fusion Claw: agents do real work, within clear limits.
subjudul: Oracle Fusion Claw (Sep 29): agents do real work in core business systems — with firm permission boundaries.
